lines.text: Many learners say: There are much people here.
Better: There are many people here.
We can count people, so we use many.

data.why: We can count people, so we use many.

native.tip: हिंदी में “बहुत लोग” का “बहुत” एक ही शब्द है, पर अंग्रेज़ी में गिने जा सकने वाले लोगों के साथ many आता है, much नहीं।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “There are much people here.” 😅 सही रूप है “There are many people here.” क्योंकि लोग गिने जा सकते हैं, इसलिए many आता है। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “many”। अब इसी तरह अपना एक वाक्य लिखिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Hindi uses one word for a lot, but English uses many with people.
en.caption: Do you say this? “There are much people here.” 😅 The right way is “There are many people here.” This is right because we can count people. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
